headline: BOS @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 3.88 at ATL 4.55, with a projected total of 8.44. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: BOS moved +0.40 runs while ATL moved -0.13, changing the projected margin by +0.54 runs. NRFI probability rose +10.7%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Grant Holmes has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Drake Baldwin, Ceddanne Rafaela, Wilyer Abreu, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ozzie Albies, Caleb Durbin because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
